name: Namer heavy APC / IFV
armament: Samson RCWS with 12.7 mm M2 or 40 mm Mk 19
IFV: unmanned 30 mm turret with Spike-MR pod
protection: Merkava Mk 4 chassis with heavy modular composite armour, V belly pack, Trophy APS. Game rule: immune to small-calibre; 7.62x54R and 12.7/14.5 mm only damage optics, tracks and exposed crew; penetration needs launchers (RPG-7 PG-7V, AT4, MAAWS, SMAW, NLAW, Javelin) or cannon, best against side, rear and engine deck.
visual_notes: Merkava Mk 4 hull and running gear (6 road wheels, side skirts) with no turret
Raised flat-roof troop compartment, two roof hatches, Samson RCWS on the left
Wide rear ramp door with sniper port
Trophy radar panels on the hull sides; anti-drone mesh common
